task: In Production, set up (but do not start) an experiment named "order_tracking_v2_copy test" on the multivariate flag "order_tracking_v2_copy". Hypothesis: "Get it today" increases signup completed versus "Buy now". The primary metric "signup_completed" should increase, and "refund_requested" is a guardrail that should not increase. Split users evenly between the control and the variation.

changes.after: "Get it today" increases signup completed versus "Buy now"

finalText: DONE: Created experiment "order_tracking_v2_copy test" (id 4) in Production on the `order_tracking_v2_copy` flag with status "created" and not started. Control is "Buy now" and variant "Get it today" gets 50%, with the rollout at 100% and disabled. Metrics: signup_completed should increase, refund_requested should not increase. The production flag itself is unchanged (still on, default "Buy now", variant weight 0%). The CLI has no experiment commands, so I created it through the Flagsmith API.
